human.wilderness_description: Tilting fence-lines and half-worked fields. Humans farm the soft edges of the wild.

orc.wilderness_description: Burned ridges and bone-marked trails. The ground remembers old raids.

high-elf.wilderness_description: Pale trees and quiet light. Paths seem to decide themselves.

dark-elf.wilderness_description: A sunken track under blackstone shelves. Shadows keep their own counsel.

demon.wilderness_description: Warm cracks in the ground and air that tastes of metal. Nothing here is entirely natural.

dwarf.wilderness_description: Quarry slopes and wind-bitten switchbacks leading toward the hold.

main_city.name: Crossroads
main_city.description: The main city — markets, halls, and roads that lead everywhere else.
